configurations.name: frontend-dev
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/caos/frontend" && exec npm run dev

configurations.name: qa-backend
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/caos/server" && ENVIRONMENT=development SESSION_SECRET=dev-preview-session-secret exec .venv/bin/uvicorn caos.http:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010

configurations.name: qa-frontend
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/caos/frontend" && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL='http://localhost:8010' PORT=3010 exec npm run dev
